en.text: Joshua got up early in the morning; and they moved from Shittim and came to the Jordan, he and all the children of Israel. They camped there before they crossed over.

zhSimplified.text: 约书亚清早起来，和以色列众人都离开什亭，来到约旦河，就住在那里，等候过河。

zhTraditional.text: 約書亞清早起來，和以色列眾人都離開什亭，來到約旦河，就住在那裏，等候過河。

en.text: After three days, the officers went through the middle of the camp;

zhSimplified.text: 过了三天，官长走遍营中，

zhTraditional.text: 過了三天，官長走遍營中，

en.text: and they commanded the people, saying, “When you see the ark of the LORD your God’s covenant, and the Levitical priests bearing it, then leave your place and follow it.

zhSimplified.text: 吩咐百姓说：「你们看见耶和华—你们 神的约柜，又见祭司利未人抬着，就要离开所住的地方，跟着约柜去。

zhTraditional.text: 吩咐百姓說：「你們看見耶和華－你們上帝的約櫃，又見祭司利未人抬着，就要離開所住的地方，跟着約櫃去。

en.text: Yet there shall be a space between you and it of about two thousand cubits by measure—don’t come closer to it—that you may know the way by which you must go; for you have not passed this way before.”

footnotes.text: 3:4 A cubit is the length from the tip of the middle finger to the elbow on a man’s arm, or about 18 inches or 46 centimeters, so 2,000 cubits is about 920 meters.

zhSimplified.text: 只是你们和约柜相离要量二千肘，不可与约柜相近，使你们知道所当走的路，因为这条路你们向来没有走过。」

zhTraditional.text: 只是你們和約櫃相離要量二千肘，不可與約櫃相近，使你們知道所當走的路，因為這條路你們向來沒有走過。」

en.text: Joshua said to the people, “Sanctify yourselves; for tomorrow the LORD will do wonders among you.”

zhSimplified.text: 约书亚吩咐百姓说：「你们要自洁，因为明天耶和华必在你们中间行奇事。」

zhTraditional.text: 約書亞吩咐百姓說：「你們要自潔，因為明天耶和華必在你們中間行奇事。」

en.text: Joshua spoke to the priests, saying, “Take up the ark of the covenant, and cross over before the people.” They took up the ark of the covenant, and went before the people.

zhSimplified.text: 约书亚又吩咐祭司说：「你们抬起约柜，在百姓前头过去。」于是他们抬起约柜，在百姓前头走。

zhTraditional.text: 約書亞又吩咐祭司說：「你們抬起約櫃，在百姓前頭過去。」於是他們抬起約櫃，在百姓前頭走。

en.text: The LORD said to Joshua, “Today I will begin to magnify you in the sight of all Israel, that they may know that as I was with Moses, so I will be with you.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华对约书亚说：「从今日起，我必使你在以色列众人眼前尊大，使他们知道我怎样与摩西同在，也必照样与你同在。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華對約書亞說：「從今日起，我必使你在以色列眾人眼前尊大，使他們知道我怎樣與摩西同在，也必照樣與你同在。

en.text: You shall command the priests who bear the ark of the covenant, saying, ‘When you come to the brink of the waters of the Jordan, you shall stand still in the Jordan.’”

zhSimplified.text: 你要吩咐抬约柜的祭司说：『你们到了约旦河的水边上，就要在约旦河水里站住。』」

zhTraditional.text: 你要吩咐抬約櫃的祭司說：『你們到了約旦河的水邊上，就要在約旦河水裏站住。』」

en.text: Joshua said to the children of Israel, “Come here, and hear the words of the LORD your God.”

zhSimplified.text: 约书亚对以色列人说：「你们近前来，听耶和华—你们 神的话。」

zhTraditional.text: 約書亞對以色列人說：「你們近前來，聽耶和華－你們上帝的話。」

en.text: Joshua said, “By this you shall know that the living God is among you, and that he will without fail drive the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Hivite, the Perizzite, the Girgashite, the Amorite, and the Jebusite out from before you.

zhSimplified.text: 约书亚说：「看哪，普天下主的约柜必在你们前头过去，到约旦河里，因此你们就知道在你们中间有永生 神；并且他必在你们面前赶出迦南人、赫人、希未人、比利洗人、革迦撒人、亚摩利人、耶布斯人。

zhTraditional.text: 約書亞說：「看哪，普天下主的約櫃必在你們前頭過去，到約旦河裏，因此你們就知道在你們中間有永生上帝；並且他必在你們面前趕出迦南人、赫人、希未人、比利洗人、革迦撒人、亞摩利人、耶布斯人。

en.text: Behold, the ark of the covenant of the Lord of all the earth passes over before you into the Jordan.
Now therefore take twelve men out of the tribes of Israel, for every tribe a man.

zhSimplified.text: 你们现在要从以色列支派中拣选十二个人，每支派一人，

zhTraditional.text: 你們現在要從以色列支派中揀選十二個人，每支派一人，

en.text: It shall be that when the soles of the feet of the priests who bear the ark of GOD, the Lord of all the earth, rest in the waters of the Jordan, that the waters of the Jordan will be cut off. The waters that come down from above shall stand in one heap.”

footnotes.text: 3:13 When rendered in ALL CAPITAL LETTERS, “LORD” or “GOD” is the translation of God’s Proper Name (Hebrew “יהוה*”, usually pronounced Yahweh).

zhSimplified.text: 等到抬普天下主耶和华约柜的祭司把脚站在约旦河水里，约旦河的水，就是从上往下流的水，必然断绝，立起成垒。」

zhTraditional.text: 等到抬普天下主耶和華約櫃的祭司把腳站在約旦河水裏，約旦河的水，就是從上往下流的水，必然斷絕，立起成壘。」

en.text: When the people moved from their tents to pass over the Jordan, the priests who bore the ark of the covenant being before the people,

zhSimplified.text: 百姓离开帐棚要过约旦河的时候，抬约柜的祭司乃在百姓的前头。

zhTraditional.text: 百姓離開帳棚要過約旦河的時候，抬約櫃的祭司乃在百姓的前頭。

en.text: and when those who bore the ark had come to the Jordan, and the feet of the priests who bore the ark had dipped in the edge of the water (for the Jordan overflows all its banks all the time of harvest),

zhSimplified.text: 他们到了约旦河，脚一入水（原来约旦河水在收割的日子涨过两岸），

zhTraditional.text: 他們到了約旦河，腳一入水（原來約旦河水在收割的日子漲過兩岸），

en.text: the waters which came down from above stood, and rose up in one heap a great way off, at Adam, the city that is beside Zarethan; and those that went down toward the sea of the Arabah, even the Salt Sea, were wholly cut off. Then the people passed over near Jericho.

zhSimplified.text: 那从上往下流的水便在极远之地、撒拉但旁的亚当城那里停住，立起成垒；那往亚拉巴的海，就是盐海，下流的水全然断绝。于是百姓在耶利哥的对面过去了。

zhTraditional.text: 那從上往下流的水便在極遠之地、撒拉但旁的亞當城那裏停住，立起成壘；那往亞拉巴的海，就是鹽海，下流的水全然斷絕。於是百姓在耶利哥的對面過去了。

en.text: The priests who bore the ark of the LORD’s covenant stood firm on dry ground in the middle of the Jordan; and all Israel crossed over on dry ground, until all the nation had passed completely over the Jordan.

zhSimplified.text: 抬耶和华约柜的祭司在约旦河中的干地上站定，以色列众人都从干地上过去，直到国民尽都过了约旦河。

zhTraditional.text: 抬耶和華約櫃的祭司在約旦河中的乾地上站定，以色列眾人都從乾地上過去，直到國民盡都過了約旦河。
